visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens with a wide shot of a traditional street-side waffle stall titled '光遠鬆餅坊'. Two customers are seated on blue plastic chairs in the foreground, backs to the camera, while the vendor's cart is visible inside the shop entrance. (2) Close-up of a waffle iron; hands wearing white gloves use a spoon to scatter yellow corn kernels and a pair of tongs to place a slice of pink ham onto the cooked waffle batter. (3) A sequence of macro shots follows, showcasing cross-sections of various waffles: one filled with green cucumber shreds and tuna, another with thick, oozing dark chocolate sauce, and a third drizzled with yellow honey and butter. (4) Hands are seen tearing into a chocolate-filled waffle, with the sauce dripping between the grid patterns. (5) The camera pans across a stack of prepared waffles cooling inside a glass display case. (6) The final shot returns to the stall front with an orange and white banner overlay providing the specific address in Kaohsiung.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 高雄有一間開了. [Logo]: @hooleefun. (2) [Subtitle]: 31年的鬆餅店. (3) [Subtitle]: 是很多人從小吃到大的味道. (4) [Subtitle]: 他們家的鬆餅是自己調製麵糊. (5) [Subtitle]: 烤出來紮實帶點鬆軟. (6) [Subtitle]: 有點像雞蛋糕. (7) [Subtitle]: 鹹口味推薦鮪魚鬆餅. (8) [Subtitle]: 夾了滿滿鮪魚和小黃瓜絲. (9) [Subtitle]: 加上黑胡椒清爽又唰嘴. (10) [Subtitle]: 甜食控一定要試試巧克力鬆餅. (11) [Subtitle]: 咬下去會爆漿. (12) [Subtitle]: 甜中帶點微苦超級療癒. (13) [Subtitle]: 還有蜂蜜加奶油的組合. (14) [Subtitle]: 甜香微鹹讓人一口接一口. (15) [Subtitle]: 鬆餅每天限量供應. (16) [Subtitle]: 想吃的話記得要早點來. (17) [Subtitle]: 我們是虎麗笑嗨嗨. [Slogan]: 光遠鬆餅坊 雄市前金區自強三路245號. (18) [Subtitle]: 下次再一起吃美食囉.
